create_carracing_env: create a CarRacing gym environment instance with optional verbose flag for debugging
run_carracing_episode: run a CarRacing episode by calling reset then stepping with steer gas brake actions
render_carracing: render the CarRacing environment in human rgb_array or state_pixels mode
register_carracing_gym: register the CarRacing-Vanilla-v0 environment with gym using gym_register entry point
create_track_carracing: create a random racing track with checkpoints and border tiles via _create_track
